visual_evidence: A narrow straight center bus spans most of the footprint.
A folded upper guide has two left-facing ends and a right-hand U-turn.
A folded lower guide has two right-facing ends and a left-hand U-turn.
The inner arms of both folded guides contain long periodic segmented sections adjacent to the center bus.
topology_reasoning.operation: The long periodic inner sections provide distributed, phase-matched coupling between the folded outer guides and the straight center bus. The folded returns route the outer channels back to the same side while preserving a very long interaction region in a compact footprint.
topology_reasoning.geometry_plan: Use gf.Path plus extrude for the curved folded returns, straight/taper primitives for terminal and solid sections, and rectangle primitives for each periodic tooth. Keep all functional dimensions as live top-level numeric assignments.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only topology: three guides, two folded returns, paired periodic coupling sections, tapers, and center bus.
Corrected grating count/phase and turn centerlines; widened return arms. The widened endpoint pushed the GDS bbox to 0.724 um and degraded vertical registration, so it was not retained unchanged.
Restored the 0.700 um vertical frame with separate curve, return, and tooth widths; retained the corrected grating phase and refined turn centerlines.

Added two measured chirp phase corrections to the paired gratings, lengthened the lower terminal taper, and tightened the upper/right and lower/left turn centerlines. Stop criterion IoU >= 0.85 reached.
